newsitem.title: USA: Family found shot dead in Florida.
newsitem.headline: Family found shot dead in Florida.

text.p: Police Thursday searched for clues in the brutal murders of four members of the same family, including an infant and her 3-year-old sister.

Two-month-old Sabrina Altidor, her sister Samantha, 3, their mother, Maria Carmel Altidor, 29, and their grandmother, Therisa Laverne, 60, were found shot dead in their home in this Fort Lauderdale suburb Wednesday.

Police were alerted to the killing when Maria Altidor's husband, George, called home from his job and became concerned when no one answered the telephone. They said he alerted his brother-in-law, Rochener Seraphin, and asked him to check the house.
